concepts.gloss_en: The essence/main point of the rectification of the mentalities (mochin)

reason_for_human: Single occurrence; the phrase is a construct headed by עִקָּר ('the essence of'), asserting that the tikkun of the mochin is achieved by breaking sexual lust. It is a statement about the rectification, not a standalone named concept, and there is nothing to merge or split. Grouping stands as-is.
